title: Disney World & the Wish
subtitle: Sep 5–14, 2026, with Jason and Jenny. A Northeast Florida coast stamp run on Sunday, four Walt Disney World park days, then Halloween on the High Seas aboard the Disney Wish.

days.label: Day 0
days.title: Fly to Orlando
days.html:
✈︎

SFO → MCO

United UA 583 · SFO 8:15 AM → MCO 4:44 PM · conf. JDWWKL.

Rental car from MCO to Coronado Springs for two nights, then an easy evening of dinner and wandering at Disney Springs.

days.label: Day 1
days.title: Northeast Florida stamp run
days.sub: Coronado Springs → New Smyrna → St. Augustine → Jacksonville → Coronado Springs
days.cut: Planned as six stops up into Georgia; the day ran south to north and stopped after Fort Caroline. Cumberland Island NS (St. Marys) and Fort Frederica NM (St. Simons Island) are saved for a future Georgia coast run. Times here are approximate.

days.label: Days 2–5
days.title: Walt Disney World
days.html:
🏰

Four park days

Moved from Coronado Springs to Saratoga Springs (DVC) on Monday, all four of you through Friday.

Mon Sep 7 · Hollywood Studios
Tue Sep 8 · Animal Kingdom
Wed Sep 9 · EPCOT
Thu Sep 10 · Magic Kingdom

Joanne brought her own wheelchair, so no ECV rental.

days.label: Days 6–8
days.title: The Disney Wish
days.sub: Halloween on the High Seas from Port Canaveral
days.html:
🚢

Halloween on the High Seas

Disney transportation from Saratoga Springs to Port Canaveral on Friday, Sep 11, and aboard the Disney Wish for three nights.

Joanne & John: res. #44363623, category 07A, 8:15 PM dining. Jason & Jenny: res. #44685575, stateroom 9172.

days.label: Day 9
days.title: Debark & fly home
days.cut: Disney transportation from the port to MCO.

stops.via: I-4 east to I-95, then to the north (Apollo Beach) entrance.
stops.name: Canaveral NS
stops.addr: Apollo Beach Visitor Center, 7611 S Atlantic Ave, New Smyrna Beach, FL
stops.ok: North entrance only; there’s no through-road to the Playalinda side.
stops.about: The longest stretch of undeveloped beach on Florida’s Atlantic coast, next door to the Kennedy Space Center.

stops.via: North on I-95, then A1A onto Anastasia Island.
stops.name: Fort Matanzas NM
stops.addr: Fort Matanzas National Monument, 8636 A1A S, St. Augustine, FL
stops.ok: The stamp is at the visitor center; the ferry only goes out to the fort itself.
stops.about: A small 1740s Spanish coquina watchtower guarding St. Augustine’s back door at Matanzas Inlet.

stops.name: Castillo de San Marcos NM
stops.addr: Castillo de San Marcos, 1 S Castillo Dr, St. Augustine, FL
stops.ok: On-site paid parking, or a 10-minute walk from the Historic Downtown garage.
stops.about: The oldest masonry fort in the continental U.S., built of coquina by Spain starting in 1672.

stops.via: North on I-95 and across the St. Johns to the Fort Caroline visitor center.
stops.name: Timucuan Preserve
stops.addr: Timucuan Preserve Visitor Center, 12713 Fort Caroline Rd, Jacksonville, FL
stops.ok: The last stop of the day; Cumberland Island and Fort Frederica were left for another trip.
stops.about: Salt marshes, waterways and history at the mouth of the St. Johns River, including the site of the 1564 French Fort Caroline.

stops.via: I-95 south, then I-4 west. Returned the rental at the Disney Car Care Center.
stops.name: Coronado Springs
stops.addr: Disney's Coronado Springs Resort, Lake Buena Vista, FL
stops.note: Second night at Coronado Springs; tomorrow it’s over to Saratoga Springs.

stops.title: Orlando → home
stops.note: Disney transportation from the ship to MCO. United UA 425, MCO 3:00 PM → SFO 5:50 PM.
